Candidates should regularly check the KEA website for examination and admit card updates.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka PU Lecturer Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Government has issued a detailed 16-page Kannada recruitment notification dated 26 November 2026 for direct recruitment of 778 Pre-University Lecturers under the Residual Parent Cadre. The notification contains subject-wise vacancies, eligibility, age limits, salary, application fees, examination pattern, reservation provisions, syllabus-related instructions and application deadlines. Official Notification PDF: Karnataka Examinations Authority Notification PDF Candidates should download the official PDF titled PU_RPC_NOTI_26112026kannada.pdf from the recruitment notification section.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka PU Lecturer Vacancy 2026 - 778 Posts
content_sections.text: The Karnataka Government has announced 778 lecturer vacancies across 13 subjects under the Residual Parent Cadre. These include 773 regular and five backlog vacancies. Vacancy Highlight: Commerce has 146 vacancies, English has 140, Computer Science has 108, Economics has 85 and Kannada has 84. These five subjects account for a substantial share of the advertised vacancies. The five backlog vacancies are distributed across Kannada, English, Economics, Commerce and Computer Science, with one backlog position in each subject. Important: The notification states that vacancies may be revised according to applicable Government orders and departmental requirements. Category-wise reservation and allocation must be checked through the official recruitment documents and KEA instructions.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka PU Lecturer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the prescribed subject-wise postgraduate qualification and teacher education qualification, except where the notification provides a separate eligibility route. For most advertised subjects, the applicant must possess: A second-class Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant subject. A Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) Degree or equivalent qualification. The required qualification from a recognized university or institution. For eligible Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe candidates, the notification prescribes a minimum of 50% marks in the relevant Master's Degree , together with B.Ed. or equivalent. Computer Science has additional qualification alternatives, which candidates should verify separately. Important: The subject-wise list summarizes the official eligibility table. Applicants must check the complete wording of the accepted degree titles in the notification, especially for Kannada, Chemistry and Computer Science. The notification specifies additional qualifications for Computer Science Lecturer recruitment. Accepted routes include a relevant second-class postgraduate qualification with at least 55% marks, such as MCA, M.Sc. Computer Science, M.Tech. or ME in Computer Science or Information Science and Engineering. The notification also identifies a second-class Bachelor's Degree with at least 55% marks in BE Computer Science or BE Information Science as an accepted qualification route. Important: The general Master's Degree with B.Ed. requirement and the Computer Science alternatives should not be treated as identical. Candidates must check the complete subject-specific provisions before applying. Yes. Candidates with a second-class Master's Degree in Commerce meeting the required percentage and holding B.Ed. or an accepted equivalent qualification can apply for Commerce Lecturer vacancies. Yes. Candidates possessing the required Master's Degree in English and B.Ed. or equivalent can apply, subject to the minimum marks, age and other conditions. Yes. Candidates with recognized MSc qualifications in the relevant notified science subject can apply if they meet the subject-specific and teacher education requirements.

content_sections.text: KEA has prescribed category-wise application fees for the recruitment. Fee Payment Last Date: 26 December 2026. The notification states that the prescribed application fee is non-refundable. Candidates must complete payment through the facility provided by KEA.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka PU Lecturer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the competitive recruitment procedure prescribed by KEA. Online application and eligibility scrutiny. Compulsory Kannada Language Examination, where applicable. Competitive Examination - Paper 1. Competitive Examination - Paper 2. Preparation of the merit list according to the prescribed examination rules. Verification of educational qualification and reservation certificates. Final selection and appointment formalities. The compulsory Kannada Language Examination is qualifying in nature. Candidates must satisfy its minimum qualifying standard to remain eligible for the competitive recruitment process, unless exempt under applicable rules.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka PU Lecturer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The examination will be conducted in offline OMR mode. The notification provides a compulsory Kannada examination and two competitive examination papers. Important: The compulsory Kannada Language Examination is qualifying and its marks are not added to the competitive examination merit score. The Kannada Language Examination carries 150 marks and has a duration of three hours. The notification prescribes a minimum qualifying requirement of 50 marks in the compulsory Kannada examination. Candidates who meet the prescribed exemption conditions should follow the relevant notification instructions. The competitive examination contains two papers based on the relevant syllabus specified for the recruitment. The question papers will cover the prescribed recruitment syllabus. Candidates should consult the official KEA syllabus and examination instructions for the detailed paper-wise topic distribution. The notification prescribes negative marking for incorrect answers in the competitive examination. Each correct answer carries one mark. Each incorrect answer attracts a deduction of 0.25 mark . Candidates must follow the official OMR marking instructions. The final examination schedule and detailed instructions will be published separately by KEA.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka PU Lecturer Recruitment 2026 Reservation
content_sections.text: The recruitment includes reservation provisions under the applicable Karnataka Government rules. Reservation categories include: Scheduled Castes. Scheduled Tribes. Category-I. Category 2A, 2B, 3A and 3B. Eligible rural candidates. Kannada-medium candidates. Women candidates. Persons with Disabilities. Ex-Servicemen. Eligible Sportspersons. Other categories specifically covered by Government orders. Applicants must possess valid reservation and eligibility certificates in the prescribed formats. Important: This notification applies to the Residual Parent Cadre. Candidates seeking benefits under the separate Kalyana Karnataka recruitment must refer to that recruitment's notification and eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Karnataka PU Lecturer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants should keep the following documents ready, depending on their qualification and reservation category: SSLC or equivalent certificate for proof of date of birth. PUC / Class 12 certificate and marks card. Relevant Bachelor's Degree certificate and marksheets. Relevant Master's Degree certificate and semester-wise marksheets. University recognition or equivalence certificate, where required. SC/ST/Category-I/2A/2B/3A/3B certificate, where applicable. Income and caste certificate in the prescribed format, where applicable. Rural candidate certificate, where applicable. Kannada-medium study certificate, where applicable. Disability certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen certificate, where applicable. Sportsperson certificate, where applicable. Valid Government-issued photo identity proof. Recent passport-size photograph. Prescribed scanned documents and signatures. Submitted application form and fee payment confirmation. Original certificates must be produced when required by KEA or the recruiting department.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India. Must score at least 50 marks in the qualifying Kannada Language Paper. Must be mentally and physically healthy and free from any physical defect likely to interfere with duties. Lecturers must also teach classes 9 and 10 in institutions specified by the Government, along with I and II PUC.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have written the qualifying examination and are awaiting results. Persons permanently debarred by UPSC, any State PSC, KEA or any recruitment examination. A man with more than one living wife, or a woman married to a man with a living wife, without prior Government permission. Persons convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude or temporarily debarred, until the Government considers them eligible.
